name: Vamp
subtitle: Independent apps for iPhone and iPad
description: Official AltStore source for Boo Player, Vamp Assistant, and Vamp Stream.

apps.name: Boo Player
apps.subtitle: Fast IPTV playback with live TV, movies, series, and EPG.
apps.localizedDescription: Import M3U or Xtream playlists, browse live channels, films and series, search your catalog, save favorites, and view programme guide information in English, Turkish, or Russian.

versions.localizedDescription: Fixes channel-list scrolling flicker, Turkish playlist text and search, favorite-button behavior, accessibility, and localized channel browsing.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Boo Player uses local network access to discover and connect to IPTV servers for live TV and video streaming.
privacy.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: Boo Player uses the advertising identifier to show relevant ads and keep the app free.

apps.name: Vamp Assistant
apps.subtitle: Control your trusted Mac and continue Assistant sessions remotely.
apps.localizedDescription: Pair with Vamp Assistant on your Mac to continue sessions, approve requests, exchange files, stream and control the Mac, and securely unlock it through Tailscale.

versions.localizedDescription: Adds saved drafts and connection diagnostics; fixes Mac switching, notification routing, duplicate sends, pairing recovery, and large-text pairing layout.
Makes secure Mac unlock complete at the physical login window and adds richer remote settings, model selection, bot console, approval previews, and stream recovery.
Adds visible version and build information plus the secure Tailscale-only Mac unlock flow.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Vamp Assistant scans the one-time pairing QR code shown by your Mac.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Vamp Assistant connects to Vamp Assistant running on your trusted Mac.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Vamp Assistant can dictate text onto your Mac from the Control keyboard.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Vamp Assistant turns on-device speech into keystrokes on your Mac.

apps.name: Vamp Stream
apps.subtitle: Focused visual control for a trusted Mac.
apps.localizedDescription: Open a Mac app window from Vamp Sync, or use app-window and full-display streaming through Vamp Assistant, over a trusted LAN or private Tailscale network.

versions.localizedDescription: Removes the startup Waiting for video flash. Immediate frame feedback, compact recovery for sustained video delays, and accessible Retry controls. Portrait-only.
Clearer controls help with a reachable Done button, one-finger picture adjustment, and recovery from a stuck connection spinner. Portrait-only with direct app launching and opt-in Mac resizing.
Makes the whole app card tappable in Sync and Assistant, fixing taps on blank card space. Keeps portrait-only layout and direct app launching without a window popup.

Matching Fit window and Larger text controls for Sync and Assistant, zoom preserved across keyboard/layout changes, and safer sizing requests that keep the latest choice. Portrait-only with opt-in Mac resizing.

Fixes landscape switching and the automatic window-selection popup. Opens apps directly, preserves Mac window sizing by default, and makes adaptive resizing opt-in. Portrait-only; full-screen on iPad.

Improves app-window rotation, resize coordination, stale-event filtering, input safety, and exact-window reconnect. Adaptive Sync resizing requires updated host support. Live device acceptance testing remains incomplete.
Adds Close on running Mac apps, and matches app-list search, pairing, and empty states to the connect-home glass.
Adds a header control that switches paired Sync and Assistant Macs between the list and Control-style rectangular cards.
Uses the window-and-fangs mark, lets you dismiss the Sync download card, and minimizes the connect card after a host is paired.
Adds a host picker for Vamp Sync and Vamp Assistant, a quieter connect home, and a card that opens the latest Vamp Sync download.
Keeps two-finger scrolling directed at the Mac app at any zoom level. Adds Adjust view for pinch and pan, and releases long-press dragging when you lift your finger.
Adds app search, favorites, recents, window selection and quality controls. Improves input delivery, app switching, QR recovery, keyboard layout and accessibility.
Uses Vamp Sync naming throughout app-window pairing and discovery. Connect with Sync or a paired Assistant.
Keeps the complete top and title area visible for tall Vamp Assistant app windows by reserving Vamp Stream's controls outside the video viewport.
Fixes Vamp Assistant app streaming on a locked Mac: reachable Macs stay online, the secure password unlock screen appears before the app picker, and app launch waits until macOS is unlocked.
Reliably opens the secure Mac-password unlock screen when connecting to an already locked Vamp Sync or Vamp Host.
Improves stream sharpness: Vamp Sync now honors Quality and Ultra requests, and Vamp Assistant streams default to the native-resolution profile.
Adds the authenticated Mac-password unlock form for Vamp Assistant and recognizes the Remote Unlock policy exposed by Vamp Sync.
Previous sideloadable iPhone and iPad release.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Vamp Stream uses the camera to scan private Vamp Sync or Vamp Assistant pairing QR codes.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Vamp Stream uses your local network to discover and connect to Macs running Vamp Sync or Vamp Assistant.
